normalized_task.title: Create a fictional veterinary appointment with safe persistence boundaries
constraints: Use only the already-supported project runtime for the disposable pilot
Keep the API, data, migration, transaction, replay, race, reliability, observability, and test boundaries explicit
Use fictional records and a bounded isolated workspace
Do not mutate installed or global capability sources
acceptance_criteria: A versioned create route validates bounded input and returns a stable envelope
Actor authorization and client/patient ownership are enforced
Appointment and idempotency state commit atomically
A unique appointment slot cannot be booked twice under concurrent requests
Same request replay returns one effect and changed-payload reuse is rejected
Migration apply, repeat, checksum, preservation, and failure behavior are observed
Errors and structured events are bounded and redacted
Evidence-shaped tests and a read-only verifier handoff are current
